title: Spherical cavity, radius 10 mm, on a curved unstructured mesh: the TM11 triplet
source: Spherical cavity resonances: TM_{n1} at the roots of [x j_n(x)]' = 0, x'₁₁ = 2.743707269992269 (TM11, three-fold), f = c x/(2π a) (R. F. Harrington, Time-Harmonic Electromagnetic Fields, 1961, §6-7; the root found here by bisection to 1e-15)
